     3	## Brand
     4	DeployCloud Blog is the content hub for DeployCloud, a cloud deployment platform serving developers, engineering teams, and technical decision-makers. The blog features engineering insights, product updates, customer stories, and community perspectives on cloud infrastructure, AI agents, and developer tools. The tone is professional, modern, and editorial.

    11	- **Core Platform:** CI/CD (Helping teams ship 6× faster) · Content Delivery (Fast, scalable, and reliable) · Fluid Compute (Servers, in serverless form) · Workflows (Long-running workflows at scale) · Observability (Trace every step)

    39	1. **Agentic Infrastructure** — Apr 9 · By Tom Reeves

Then, a more important shift: infrastructure derived from the application itself. LLMs and coding agents are driving the next transition, and it's happening fast.
    41

    43	   The gap between prototypes and production-ready systems is huge. Code that's trivial to run locally falls apart the moment it needs to handle failures, restarts, and real traffic. Framework-defined infrastructure solved this for web applications. Workflows extends that model to long-running systems.
    44

    46	   The following is based on an internal talk given at DeployCloud. We're sharing it publicly because the problem it describes isn't unique to us, and the framework is useful for any team shipping with agents. Coding agents generate code at unprecedented speeds — but without rigorous judgment, they are a fast way to ship bad assumptions directly to production.

Apr 9 · General

Agentic Infrastructure

Every generation of software eventually demands a new generation of infrastructure. First, we configured servers by hand. Next, the cloud turned infrastructure into APIs. Then, a more important shift: infrastructure derived from the application itself. LLMs and coding agents are driving the next transition, and it's happening fast.

TR Tom Reeves
Apr 16 · General

A new programming model for durable execution

The gap between prototypes and production-ready systems is huge. Code that's trivial to run locally falls apart the moment it needs to handle failures, restarts, and real traffic. Framework-defined infrastructure solved this for web applications. Workflows extends that model to long-running systems.

PM Pranav Mehta
Mar 30 · General

Agent responsibly

We're sharing it publicly because the problem it describes isn't unique to us, and the framework is useful for any team shipping with agents. Coding agents generate code at unprecedented speeds — but without rigorous judgment, they are a fast way to ship bad assumptions directly to production.

steps.message:
The DeployCloud blog landing page has been built and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

### Sections & Features
- **Header** — Sticky navigation with logo, top-level links, and two mega-menu dropdowns (Products, Resources) with hover/click interaction
- **Category Filters** — Horizontal pill buttons (All Posts, Engineering, Community, Company News, Customers, v0, Security, Changelog, Press) with active state highlighting
- **Search** — Input with icon that filters posts by title, excerpt, or author in real time; shows "No results found at this time. Try again with a different keyword." when empty
- **Featured Articles** — Three prominent hero cards with patterned image placeholders, dates, titles, excerpts, and author avatars
- **Agentic Stats Ribbon** — Dark banner below featured cards displaying the five key statistics (30%, 1000%, 20×, 2×, 75%)
- **Latest News Grid** — 3-column responsive grid of blog post cards with category tags, dates, titles, excerpts, and authors
- **Show More Posts** — Button that progressively reveals 4 additional pre-loaded cards at a time
- **CTA Banner** — Centered call-to-action with primary and secondary buttons, plus an Enterprise block
- **Footer** — Full multi-column footer with all link categories and a status badge

### Design & Interactions
- **Brand colors** — `#171717` primary, `#0072F5` accent, `#FAFAFA` background
- **Typography** — Inter font with bold headlines and generous line-height
- **Responsive** — 3-col → 2-col → 1-col grids; sticky header/filters adjust for mobile; search input expands on focus
- **Hover states** — Cards lift with shadow on hover; pills and nav links have smooth transitions
- **Dropdowns** — Mega menus open on hover/click and close on mouse leave or outside click
